label: pjm 18 export reprice
definition: pjm 18 keeper: run-13 base (priced interchange, measured monthly gas, dual-fuel) + persistent PJM coal sigmoid defaults (bit ceil 1.32 from run 16; waste 1.0/2.10/4.80/2.0 revised from run-17 monthly decomposition) + export sinks repriced -$6 to stop the 2024/25 over-export that marginal gas backfilled (gas 2024 +24 TWh). All params from COAL_SIGMOID_DEFAULTS / EXPORT_TRANCHES — no per-run tuning flags Outcome: gas 2024 +24.2 -> +14.2 TWh (in the 5% cap) and 2025 near-perfect (BIT +0.4, WC +0.2, coal-total +0.6), but the deeper price trough bled cheap-gas-year coal: coal-total 2024 -6.20 (cap 5.81) and COAL_WC 2023 -1.26 — corrected in run 19 (trough sinks +$4 back, waste mid 5.3/slope 3, bit floor 0.80).
